lexicon.name: Checkout workshop
lexicon.description: A small, illustrative checkout model for trying the canvas. Follow an Order through its lines and price calculation, then attach questions, sketches, or interface examples. The source is a local teaching fixture, not a production checkout.

context.name: Ordering
context.description: Collect purchase quantities and calculate an order total.

concept.name: Order
concept.description: A purchase containing the lines whose prices contribute to its total.
concept.annotation: An order must contain at least one line before its total is calculated.
concept.code-link: The total function checks that the order has a line before summing prices.

concept.name: Order Line
concept.description: A product price and quantity purchased together.
concept.code-link: The type carries a unit price and quantity.

concept.name: Order Total
concept.description: The sum of every line's unit price multiplied by quantity. Taxes and discounts are outside this example.
concept.code-link: The total function produces this number.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.description: The Order carries its lines in the lines property.
relationship.code-link: The lines property connects the Order to OrderLine values.

relationship.name: contributes to
relationship.description: The total calculation sums the extended price of each line.
relationship.code-link: The reduce callback adds each price multiplied by quantity.

system.name: Checkout Teaching Fixture
system.description: An illustrative software boundary for experimenting with order-total calculation.

container.name: Teaching Runtime
container.description: The intended TypeScript host for checkout.ts. The fixture supplies no executable entrypoint or deployment configuration.
container.annotation: A caller must import and invoke total; no UI, server, database, or external integration is implemented.

component.name: Total Calculator
component.description: The callable total function checks for an empty order and sums extended line prices.

relationship.name: reads lines from
relationship.description: The total function receives an Order record and checks its lines length before reducing the collection. The Order participant represents that input record.
relationship.code-link: The total function receives an Order record and checks its lines length before reducing the collection. The Order participant represents that input record.

relationship.name: calculates
relationship.description: For a nonempty order, total reduces unitPrice times quantity to the numeric Order Total. This is a computation, without persistence or a separate total service.
relationship.code-link: For a nonempty order, total reduces unitPrice times quantity to the numeric Order Total. This is a computation, without persistence or a separate total service.

flow.name: Calculate an Order Total
flow.description: A caller invokes total with a nonempty Order. It reads the lines and returns their summed extended prices.
flow.code-link: Defines the scenario ordering and outcome.
flow.annotation: Caller orchestration is outside the fixture. Prices and quantities have TypeScript number types but no runtime positivity or finiteness checks.

flow.name: Reject an Empty Order
flow.description: A caller invokes total with an empty lines array. The length check throws before any total is calculated.
flow.code-link: Defines the scenario ordering and outcome.
flow.step: Read lines and reject the empty order
